create_composite_profiler: create a CompositeProfiler that aggregates multiple Profiler instances into a single profiler
start_composite_profiler: start all profilers in a CompositeProfiler by calling its start method
stop_composite_profiler: stop all profilers in a CompositeProfiler by calling its stop method
step_composite_profiler: advance all profilers in a CompositeProfiler by calling its step method
review_composite_profiler_class: review the CompositeProfiler class that delegates start, stop, and step to a sequence of profilers
